title: didilili/ai-agents-from-zero: a project-based agent engineering curriculum
friendlyTitle: Learn to build AI agents from the beginning
summary: This Chinese-language learning repository covers Python agent development with LangChain, LangGraph, Dify, Coze, MCP, RAG and deployment. It combines structured chapters, runnable examples, practical projects and interview preparation in an MIT-licensed package.
friendlySummary: This Chinese-language course includes lessons, code and projects for building AI agents with popular tools.
whyItMatters: Chinese-reading developers can follow a broad route from basic LLM concepts to production-oriented agent projects, including deep research and commerce examples. The repository is best used as a guided curriculum, with library versions and security choices checked against current official documentation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it as a step-by-step learning path, and check the latest official documents when tools have changed.
